body:
1. Support Windows backslash path separators in lib/brain.mjs (#121).
2. Forward adlcBin from prosecute() to runHollowTest() in lib/prosecute.mjs (#122).
3. Remove HTTP status suppression in skills/modernize/scripts/audit.mjs fetchText() and add offline vendor/adlc/package.json fallback (#123).
4. Clamp negative/NaN offset and cap read chunk size to 1 MiB in sidecars/jetski-launcher.mjs (#124).
5. Use function replacers in lib/sweep.mjs fill().
6. Forward union of ticket.rails and storeRails to runConsensusFix in lib/scheduler.mjs and remove dead git helpers.
7. Update stale comment in lib/bootstrap.mjs and accept home parameter in checkBrainDir in lib/doctor.mjs (#126).
8. Extend scripts/check-bundle-externals.mjs to detect direct and bound createRequire calls.
title: Wave 3: Resolve runtime gate findings and open GitHub issues #121, #122, #123, #124, #126
